text:
kevin: saw a retry surge in prod around 08:22 UTC, spikes across us-west/us-east, lots of 502s and TLS handshake timeouts. from the postmortem it looks like DNS TTLs + LB fallback ordering amplified cross-region flapping. opening a follow-up to track owners + timelines.

maria: yup i pulled perf traces — there's a pattern where client retries hit a fallback pool that had a slightly different cert rotation state. handshake delays x retry window = cascading errors.

alex: can we confirm which fallback pools had mismatched certs? i have logs pointing to pool-b: cert issued 2024-11-13T07:59Z vs pool-a 07:58Z (small window but enough).

sam: i reproduced in staging: if DNS cache TTL is 300s and route change happens, some clients keep retrying to old IPs then LB sends them to fallback with slightly different router rules -> TLS SNI mismatch occasionally.

kevin: action list proposal: 1) audit cert rotation ordering and add pre-warm hooks (owner: alex, ETA: 48h) 2) reduce DNS default TTL for edge routes under active rollout from 300->60 (owner: sam, ETA: 24h) 3) add LB fallback health gating so fallback won't accept traffic until certs verified (owner: jitendra, ETA: 72h) 4) add dashboard & alert for cross-region retry rate > 1.5x baseline (owner: maria, ETA: 36h).

maria: +1 on dashboard. i'll use the "retry-rate" metric and add region breakdown. will wire to ops alerting on-call.

alex: for cert rotation i'll add a small preflight that checks certs on all pools via our cert-checker endpoint: `curl -s https://pool-b/cert-check | jq .valid` then gate rollout. adding to my PR now.

sam: changing DNS TTL — note: we need a short maintenance window and update registrar script. snippet i'll run: 
```
# update edge zone
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```
I'll coordinate with netops during the change. ETA tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

jitendra: LB gating plan: add a handshake-health check that verifies TLS negotiation and SNI for a subset of backends before marking fallback healthy. Canary it in staging then prod-once-green. I'll own infra changes and config rollback playbook.

kevin: good. also recurring incident note: this pattern (route flip + TTL + cert rotation window) has shown up 3x in last 9 months per incident history. we should add a short postmortem paragraph to the recurring-issues doc and schedule quarterly runbook review. owner: kevin, ETA: EOW.

maria: tagging follow-ups in tracker: https://redwood-internal/triage/ISSUE-4912 — added tasks + owners. i'll create sub-tasks for dashboards and runbook edits.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for DNS TTL change on 2024-11-15T09:00Z (owner: sam).

alex: quick note on rollback: if handshake-health fails after gating, run `infra rollback lb-fallback-config --to previous` and then trigger dns rebind TTL -> 300 to stabilize. I'll add commands to the playbook.

sam: i'll be on-call during the change and will post status updates in #incidents. tagging @kevin @maria for post-change verification.

kevin: thanks everyone. can each owner post a short status update in this thread when task is started + when complete. we'll do a 15m sync tomorrow 08:30 UTC to confirm gating tests.

maria: started dashboard work — will post link when panels are up.

alex: cert preflight PR up: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 (adds cert-checker + gating). staging tests passing.

jitendra: LB gating branch pushed, staging canary scheduled.

sam: DNS TTL change staged in sandbox; will run in prod tomorrow.

kevin: all good. marking checklist in postmortem follow-up doc. we'll keep an eye on retry/sni metrics for 48h after the change.

maria: noted, will alert if region retry delta > 20% within 2h of change. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Automated note: follow-up checklist updated in ISSUE-4912 by maria.
